verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party docs describe Cowork scheduled tasks, which run automatically on a recurring basis or on demand. Users describe a task once and Claude handles it on their schedule, delivering reports, briefings and summaries. The evidence comes from a dedicated help article but is thin on detail. Missing for 10: scheduling granularity and configuration details (cron or interval options, time zones), plan availability or limits, behaviour when the desktop is offline, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
